summary: Vicore Pharma Holding AB filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing an increase in outstanding shares and votes after exercise of warrants tied to Board LTIP 2023, Board LTIP 2024 and Board RSU 2025 incentive programs. A total of 117,737 share awards were exercised, delivering 118,916 shares, raising total registered shares and votes to 281,644,509, with registered share capital of SEK 140,822,253.132817. This is a routine equity-compensation administrative update with no acquisition, divestiture, tender, strategic review or forced management change; no deal terms apply, and no risk-arb angle exists.
